property: The old MAIL/RCPT/DATA transaction survives while EHLO capability advertisement becomes the standard growth surface for optional features such as SIZE, 8BITMIME, PIPELINING, STARTTLS, AUTH and DSN.

sources.supports: modern SMTP core plus extension negotiation

negative_claims: This edge does not claim all EHLO extensions existed in early SMTP.
It does not claim ESMTP replaced the core MAIL/RCPT/DATA transaction grammar.
open_questions: Build a chronological registry and implementation-support table.
notes: An old plaintext command language survives by negotiating later capabilities around its core verbs.
